official_sources.title: Title Number and UPRN Look Up technical specification

verified_claims: The National Polygon Dataset publishes HMLR index polygons for England and Wales.
Title plans and registers record the general position of boundaries unless an exact boundary has been determined.
Index polygons show the indicative location of registered titles and are not exact cadastral boundaries.
Every registered title has at least one index polygon.
Each polygon has a unique Poly_ID and links to its registered title through Title_No.
National Polygon fields include Shape, Poly_ID, Title_No, INSERT, UPDATE, Vers_No and Rec_Status.
Rec_Status distinguishes added, changed and deleted records.
INSPIRE Index Polygons are a simplified subset of the National Polygon Dataset.
The National Polygon, Title Descriptor and Title Number/UPRN lookup datasets are separated but linked by title number.
Title Number/UPRN links exist only where HMLR can establish a relationship with an AddressBase address.
A title may relate to multiple polygons and a UPRN link is not guaranteed for every registered title.
Index polygons are mapped against OS MasterMap where mapped features relate to the ownership boundary.
Ownership boundaries do not always follow mapped physical features.
Exact candidate promotion requires current candidate-specific polygon bytes, title linkage and lifecycle readback.
